title: Nourishing Silky Egyptian Oat Pilaf
description: This peppery, silky, and comforting Egyptian dish features oat milk and is shaped like nigiri, making it a unique and delicious lacto-vegetarian-friendly option. It is cooked in a kazan-cauldron for a traditional touch.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a kazan-cauldron over medium heat.
Add the black pepper, paprika, garlic powder, and salt, and stir for 1 minute.
Add the rolled oats and cook, stirring frequently, for 5 minutes or until lightly toasted.
Add the brown rice and cook, stirring frequently, for 2 minutes.
Add the oat milk and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the kazan-cauldron, and cook for 20 minutes or until the liquid is absorbed and the oats and rice are tender.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and shape into nigiri-like shapes.
Garnish with chopped scallions and serve hot.
